topics.why_in_news: Government launched Sampoornata Abhiyan 2.0 to accelerate saturation of key social-sector indicators in Aspirational Districts and Aspirational Blocks.
prelims_quick_notes: Sampoornata Abhiyan linked with Aspirational Districts Programme.
Focus on saturation of essential social-development indicators.
Targets health, nutrition, education and welfare outcomes.
Community participation and local administration important.
Programme supports inclusive and balanced regional development.
important_facts: NITI Aayog coordinates Aspirational Districts Programme.
Focus areas include health, education, agriculture and infrastructure.
Convergence, collaboration and competition are key principles.
Real-time monitoring through dashboards and indicators used extensively.
key_highlights: Focus on underserved districts and blocks.
Data-driven monitoring and ranking systems expanded.
Grassroots implementation and citizen participation encouraged.
exam_relevance: Important for Indian Society, Governance and Inclusive Development.
Useful for regional disparities and social-sector governance topics.
Can be linked with SDGs and cooperative federalism.
prelims_traps: Aspirational Districts Programme coordinated by NITI Aayog.
Programme focuses on convergence and outcome monitoring.
